title: Why Small Libraries Still Matter
passageHtml:
A Public libraries are sometimes described as old-fashioned institutions in an age of smartphones and search engines. Yet in many towns, the smallest libraries continue to attract steady visitors. Their value is not limited to lending books. They provide quiet space, internet access, local information and, for some residents, one of the few indoor places where no purchase is expected.

B The role of small libraries became especially visible when many public services moved online. Applying for jobs, renewing documents or contacting government offices often requires a device, a stable connection and confidence with digital forms. People who lack one of these may turn to library staff for help. In this sense, the library functions as a bridge between digital systems and citizens who might otherwise be excluded.

C Small libraries also preserve local memory. They may hold newspapers, photographs, oral histories and records of community groups that are rarely stored elsewhere. Large national collections are important, but they often overlook the ordinary details of a neighbourhood: the closing of a factory, the rebuilding of a school or the story behind a festival. Such materials can be invaluable to researchers and to residents trying to understand their own area.

D However, the survival of small libraries is not guaranteed. Funding bodies may judge them by the number of books borrowed or by visitor totals alone. These measures are easy to collect, but they do not capture informal advice, social contact or the confidence gained by someone who learns to use an online service. A library may therefore appear inefficient precisely because some of its most important work is hard to count.

E Volunteers can support small libraries, but they are not a complete solution. Enthusiastic volunteers may extend opening hours, organise events or help maintain local archives. Nevertheless, professional librarians bring training in information management, privacy and inclusive service. If a library depends entirely on unpaid labour, access may become uneven, changing according to who is available rather than what the community needs.

F The strongest argument for small libraries is not nostalgia. It is that they combine several modest functions in one accessible place. A parent may find a children’s activity, a job seeker may complete an application, and an elderly resident may speak to someone face to face. None of these uses alone may seem dramatic. Together, they make the small library a piece of social infrastructure that is easy to underestimate until it disappears.

questions.question: Small libraries are now used only for borrowing books.
questions.evidence: Their value is not limited to lending books.
questions.reason_ja: 設問は「本を借りるためだけ」と限定しています。しかし本文Aでは、価値は lending books に限られず、静かな場所、ネット利用、地域情報なども提供すると述べています。only が本文と矛盾するため FALSE です。

questions.question: Some people rely on library staff because online public services can be difficult to use without suitable resources.
questions.evidence: People who lack one of these may turn to library staff for help.
keyword_pairs: a device, a stable connection and confidence
turn to library staff for help
questions.reason_ja: 本文Bでは、オンライン手続きには端末・安定した接続・デジタルフォームへの自信が必要で、それらを欠く人が図書館スタッフに助けを求めると説明されています。設問の内容は本文と一致します。

questions.question: All government documents can be renewed at small libraries.
questions.evidence: renewing documents or contacting government offices often requires a device...
questions.reason_ja: 本文には renewing documents という例はありますが、「全ての書類が小さな図書館で更新可能」とまでは述べていません。範囲を広げすぎているため NOT GIVEN です。
questions.not_given_reason: 本文は、書類更新などに端末や接続が必要で、図書館が支援する場合があると述べるだけです。すべての政府書類を図書館で更新できるとは書かれていません。

questions.question: Local collections can contain details that larger collections may miss.
questions.evidence: Large national collections are important, but they often overlook the ordinary details of a neighbourhood.
questions.reason_ja: 本文Cでは、大規模な全国的コレクションは重要だが、地域の日常的な細部を見落としがちだと述べています。local collections がそうした情報を保存するという流れなので TRUE です。

questions.question: Visitor totals are a complete measure of a small library’s value.
questions.evidence: These measures are easy to collect, but they do not capture informal advice, social contact or the confidence gained...
questions.reason_ja: 本文Dでは、貸出数や来館者数は集めやすいが、非公式な助言、社会的接触、自信の獲得などを捉えられないと述べています。complete measure という設問の断定は本文と矛盾します。

questions.question: Volunteers are presented as useful but insufficient for running small libraries.
questions.evidence: Volunteers can support small libraries, but they are not a complete solution.
questions.reason_ja: 本文Eの冒頭に Volunteers can support small libraries, but they are not a complete solution. とあります。useful but insufficient がこの文の言い換えです。

questions.question: Complete the summary. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage for each answer.
questions.summaryHtml: Small libraries help people use digital services by acting as a {{7|Q7}} between online systems and citizens. They also preserve {{8|Q8}} by keeping local records. Simple statistics may fail to show the {{9|Q9}} gained by users. If libraries depend only on volunteers, access may become {{10|Q10}}.

evidence.7: the library functions as a bridge between digital systems and citizens
evidence.8: Small libraries also preserve local memory.
evidence.9: the confidence gained by someone who learns to use an online service

reason_ja.7: acting as は functions as の言い換えです。本文では図書館が digital systems と citizens の間の bridge になると述べています。
reason_ja.8: 地域の新聞・写真・聞き取り記録などを保存する役割を preserve local memory と表しています。本文中の語を使うので local memory が答えです。
reason_ja.9: 単純な統計では、オンラインサービスを使えるようになった人が得る confidence を捉えにくいと本文にあります。
reason_ja.10: volunteers only は depends entirely on unpaid labour に対応します。その結果、利用可能性が uneven になると述べられています。

questions.question: Which paragraph explains how libraries can reduce a form of digital exclusion?
questions.evidence: the library functions as a bridge between digital systems and citizens who might otherwise be excluded.
questions.reason_ja: digital exclusion は、デジタル環境やスキルがないために手続きから取り残されることです。B段落では、図書館が digital systems と citizens の bridge になると説明しています。

questions.question: Which paragraph warns that common evaluation methods may miss important library work?
questions.evidence: These measures are easy to collect, but they do not capture informal advice, social contact or the confidence gained...
keyword_pairs: number of books borrowed / visitor totals
questions.reason_ja: D段落では、本の貸出数や来館者数だけでは、図書館の重要な働きを十分に測れないと述べています。evaluation methods may miss が do not capture に対応します。

questions.question: Which paragraph best states the overall reason small libraries remain valuable?
questions.evidence: they combine several modest functions in one accessible place.
questions.reason_ja: F段落は結論に近く、小さな図書館の価値は懐古ではなく、複数の小さな機能をアクセスしやすい場所で組み合わせている点にあると述べています。
